#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination can be supplied as the first argument, via BACKUP_DEST,
# or via DEST.  It may be a local directory/mount or an scp-style host:path.
DEST="${1:-${BACKUP_DEST:-${DEST:-}}}"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination not set" >&2
    echo "usage: $0 [user@]host:/backup/path" >&2
    echo "       $0 /mnt/backups" >&2
    exit 1
fi

SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
